news.headline: Disney weighs free tier and creator clips to lift Disney+ engagement, report says
news.summary: Investing.com -- Walt Disney Company (NYSE:DIS) is overhauling Disney+ to include creator-led programming, short-form vertical video, and a free tier as it seeks to fend off digital entertainment rivals. The strategic shift, outlined in an internal presentation cited by Business Insider, signals a major push by leadership to transform the flagship streaming app into a broader digital centerpiece capable of competing directly with social platforms.
